axis_dictionary.definition: S or G representation family; retains each own case coordinates.
Native computational seed/case layer, including saved MEAN5; not independent biological replication.
Kd, Ki or original saved equal-endpoint layer; no endpoint is synthesized.
Original amplitude target; do not equate component/background/nonlinear objects.
Original four-corner or response quantity; native identity retained.

case_seed_policy: Every native arm and seed/case layer is retained in each row. MEAN5 is an original saved aggregation, not a case or a new mean. native_axis_raw_json preserves exact numeric/string JSON tokens; native_axes provides lexical navigation coordinates.
references: GATE: no four-corner reference. O_SRC: full references. PATH: restricted and renormalized original references; retain native policy tokens.
aggregation: Native seed, endpoint, operation and container layers only; ALL3_EQUAL is a saved summary, not a fourth direction.
numeric_objects: Prediction loss/g/bar_qI use saved F32 scores promoted to F64. Response Skill concerns named CPU-F64 functions, including whole q.
state_policy: FIELD_ABSENT is not null; raw_json=null with a missing state means no token; raw_json="null" is explicit saved null. Original unresolved, conditional-empty and qualification tags retain their meanings. No scientific PASS added.

fields.definition: Native saved amplitude/reference quantity. Container, quantity_id and target/function axes define this field; no label-loss interpretation is inferred.
fields.units: function-output units unless native field states otherwise
fields.conditional_scope: M and U use different absolute-value/synthesis order

fields.definition: Original saved probability/mass/fraction with its original full or qualified denominator.
fields.conditional_scope: Original denominator; numerator is not an independent sample count

fields.definition: Reference sign transitions: outer main FIT_ROW_UNIFORM sign and inner sensitivity FIT_PROTEIN_INPUT_UNIFORM sign, both ordered -1,0,+1; flattened row-major index=3*row+column. A suffix /j identifies that zero-based position.
fields.conditional_scope: Native single-seed/single-endpoint counts only; equal-weight aggregate count nulls retain NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_EQUAL_WEIGHT_AGGREGATE. Fractions keep the saved aggregation.
